name: Auntie Grub
description: A boggart sage, matriarch and apothecary with a frog familiar named Smlurf, source of many boggart parables.

timeline.summary: Auntie Grub begins telling the young boggarts the tale of four friends who raided a giant's lair.
timeline.quote: Today's tale is the story of four enterprising boggarts and how they raided a giant's lair

timeline.summary: The boggarts escape with their loot and celebrate Flib back in their burrow.
timeline.quote: They celebrated Flib—who died foolishly, yes, but in service of something greater.

pages_say.description: A boggart auntie who narrates the tale to the young boggarts in her hut.
A boggart sage, matriarch and apothecary with a frog familiar named Smlurf, source of many boggart parables.
